final: WITH town_stats AS (SELECT c.town_city, AVG(CAST(ili.product_price AS FLOAT)) as avg_price, AVG(CASE WHEN ili.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND ili.derived_total_cost != 0 THEN CAST(ili.derived_product_cost AS FLOAT) / CAST(ili.derived_total_cost AS FLOAT) END) as avg_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Order_Items oi ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id JOIN Orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.town_city), cross_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as overall_avg FROM town_stats) SELECT town_stats.town_city, town_stats.avg_price, town_stats.avg_ratio, town_stats.avg_ratio - cross_avg.overall_avg as above_average FROM town_stats, cross_avg WHERE town_stats.avg_ratio > cross_avg.overall_avg ORDER BY town_stats.avg_ratio DESC
